title: A Just and Comprehensive Strategy for Using NLP to Address Online Abuse
findings: This paper does not analyze or present any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on a general framework for addressing online abuse using NLP. The only connection to religion is a single citation in the references section that mentions the Sunni-Shia conflict in its title.

measurement_description: The paper is a position paper and does not conduct any benchmark measurements. It argues for new approaches to detecting online abuse but does not specifically measure aspects related to faith or religion.
